bio_en: Vagharshak Baghdasarian, known as Kaytsak ('Lightning'), was born in Mush in 1875 and graduated in 1892 with a gold cross from the Nersesian school of the United Society in Mush. Strong and a keen hunter, he clashed with Kurds and Turks as a youth, and the arrest of Damadian in 1893 and the Sasun events of 1894 deepened his will to fight; during the great massacres his small armed group kept close links with Serob. From 1900 he worked with Andranik and the Sasun haiduks, and in 1904 he led the mounted band 'Dzhoghk' ('Hell') across the border. He was killed with his band in its fight on the Zivin heights in June 1904.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Not the same as Kaytsak Arakel (Tigran Apajian, #259).
